tools.description: Do the work on a priority, and settle routine asks with undo. [production · app.annsa.ai · tools 8efe806f]

action.description: ship: Records completion and deploys nothing; retract undoes it. claim: Claims the priority, starts a short spec and returns holder_key. note: Appends a note; a correction is a new note with supersedes. dispatch: Posts @claude on the priority's linked GitHub issue; the person stays assigned. unclaim: Puts the work down; nothing is marked shipped. close: Closes a priority in one call, claim or PR and all; it stays under Closed. write: Replaces one spec section as a new version; text for a section that is not yours is recorded as an update. verify: Records how a line was checked, by proof kind. No ship gate. escalate: Raises a three-line ask in a person's Needs you; decides nothing. Needs `checked`: a fact you can check is not asked. One open ask per priority; the same topic updates it. resolve: Answers a routine ask the way your principles already decide it; returns use_id for undo. undo: Puts back your own resolve by use_id.
